messages:
maria: paging — getting alerts for a p99 spike on the inference gateway, started ~07:12 UTC. streaming stalls are up and tail latency is popping. p95 baseline ~300ms, now ~520ms; p99 ~2.8s.
incident-bot: Incident created: #INC-2028 latency spike - streaming stalls (auto-detected). Severity: P2. Pager routed to oncall.
kevin: on it. quick glance at control-plane logs, seeing a bunch of 5xx from config-service and tokenstore timeouts. also query volume to featureflags DB jumped.
julia: grabbed logs from the gateway: ```
2028-03-15T07:12:43Z ERROR config-fetch failed status=502 upstream="config-service" duration=420ms req_id=abc123
2028-03-15T07:12:44Z WARN auth tokenstore request timeout: context deadline exceeded
streaming: stall detected connection_id=xyz user=u-42
```
samir: metrics: config-fetch latency p50=120ms p95=1.1s p99=2.5s; featureflags DB CPU at 92%, rps up x3. tokenstore returning 429 with `Retry-After` on some calls.
maria: high level: control-plane dependency (config fetch / feature flags / tokenstore) is adding tail latency into inference path -> streaming stalls. we need immediate mitigations to bring p99 down and stop customer sessions from dropping.
kevin: immediate plan: 1) flip config fetch to cache-first fallback for runtime (force cached configs) 2) reduce retries from runtime for config/auth to avoid retry storm 3) temporary route traffic away from eu-west-1 featureflags replica if it's overloaded 4) if needed, increase read replicas on featureflags DB.
julia: I can flip the cached-config flag via the control plane, small guardrail: `POST /admin/flags/cache-fallback { \"enabled\": true }` (will gate by team). want me to do it?
maria: yes please. tag @sre-oncall when you flip. also disable control-plane -> client retries for config fetch (set retry=1).
sre-oncall: doing the cache-fallback flip now. executing: ```curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/admin/flags/cache-fallback -d '{"enabled":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***'``` applying. watching metrics. :right_arrow_curving_down:
deploy-bot: rollout started: cache-fallback=true -> 100% (canary 60s -> 100%) by julia
julia: applied retry throttle: config-fetch retries from 3 -> 1 for runtime clients. pushed a quick config.
kevin: also adding short-term rate-limit increase on tokenstore for internal controlplane clients (10k/min -> 20k/min) to avoid 429 cascade. this is temporary.
samir: after changes ~07:18 UTC: p95 fell to 360ms, p99 to 1.2s. streaming stalls decreased but still seeing periodic tails ~=1.5s for ~0.1% of requests. featureflags DB CPU dropped to ~65%.
maria: good improvement, but we still have residual tail. any slow SQLs?
kejvin: (typo) kevin: yes saw a hot query on flag evaluations: `SELECT * FROM flags WHERE segment_id = $1 ORDER BY priority DESC LIMIT 1` with sequential scans under some keys. adding index and plan change might help but is not instant. putting an index creation advisory for later.
julia: also noticed runtime KV cache evictions spike when certain customers have many active sessions -> causes more config fetches. we should enable aggressive local in-memory TTL for configs for 30m as temporary mitigation.
sre-oncall: enabling in-memory TTL 30m on controlplane runtimes now. will roll to all hosts in 2m.
maria: monitoring customer impact: list of affected customers shows higher error rates for streaming sessions with high fanout (webhooks + streaming). measured ~0.6% of total sessions experienced stalls >3s and ~0.03% disconnected. working on comms.
kevin: adding circuit-breaker: if config fetch > 500ms for controlplane, return cached config and log metric; implementing a threshold in runtime now.
samir: dashboard links: https://dash.redwood/infra/p99-latency?from=07:00&to=08:00 and slow-query list https://dash.redwood/db/slow-queries?svc=featureflags. dumping a sample slow query: ```
# slow query sample
2028-03-15 07:14:02 30s user=svc_flags duration=30240ms QUERY: SELECT * FROM flags WHERE segment_id = 'seg-9' ORDER BY priority DESC LIMIT 1;
```
maria: owner assignments: @kevin => DB followup (indexes + read replica plan), @julia => runtime short-circuit + in-memory TTL, @sre-oncall => monitoring + rollback path, @maria => customer comms + incident writeup.
sre-oncall: prepping handoff notes for night oncall (handoff at 09:00 UTC). current status: degraded p99 but under control, mitigations applied (cache fallback, retry throttle, tokenstore rate bump, in-memory TTL). residual tail remains ~0.1% of requests.
julia: confirm logs after mitigations show `config-cache served=true` marker on most requests. sample: `INFO config served_from_cache=true req_id=def456 duration=28ms`.
kevin: temporary DB ops started: scaled read replicas + open ticket for index: TKT-5421. long-term: add rollout gate for feature flags and circuit-breaker in controlplane.
maria: customer impact summary for the postmortem: small percent of streaming users experienced stalls and occasional disconnects in two regions. root cause: control-plane dependency saturation (featureflags DB and tokenstore rate limits) leading to increased config-fetch latency and retry amplification into runtime, amplifying tail latency on the inference path.
incident-bot: Incident #INC-2028 updated: mitigations applied, impact reduced. escalate to follow-up with engineering for RCA.
maria: handoff: leaving a concise runbook for the night oncall: 1) watch p99 on `inference.gateway.streaming` 2) if p99 > 1.5s, enable extra cache TTL and consider routing heavy customers to dedicated pools 3) if tokenstore 429s return, rollback tokenstore rate change and open emergency paging to infra. contact list included.
sre-oncall: acknowledged handoff. will monitor overnight. switching channel to active-alerts for metric push.
kevin: followups (short): create index TKT-5421, add guard rails for featureflag rollouts, add local in-memory cache to runtime, instrument retry amplification metric.
maria: thanks team — I'll start incident writeup and customer notes. adding links to dashboards and logs in the incident doc. closing thread for live mitigation coordination, will reopen for RCA drafting. :white_check_mark:
